changelog:
Initial release of the garmin-skill — connect and chat with your Garmin data using AI.

- Chat with your Garmin training data to analyze workouts, trends, VO2 Max, heart rate zones, and more.
- Includes open, no-auth "Workout of the Day" endpoint for generating random structured workouts.
- Supports authenticated AI coach chat, performance metrics, and chart endpoints.
- Retrieve athlete profile, workout schedule, and push workouts to Garmin.
- Clear setup instructions and usage examples provided.
- Tiered API rate limits: Free and Paid.
summary: Talk to your Garmin data — ask questions about your activities, training load, VO2 Max, heart rate zones, and more using AI.
